name: Eagle Exhumer
description: Eagle to KiCad 10 import that repairs the known importer defects, with strong quality control against the Eagle source.
description_full:
Eagle Exhumer brings old Autodesk EAGLE designs (6.x-9.x XML .sch/.brd, and binary 4.x/5.x files through a built-in converter) into KiCad 10.

After KiCad's own EAGLE importer it repairs 15 importer defects found on real boards: power nets, Eagle 'nc' pins, lost net names, package copper polygons and printed jumpers (net ties), NPTH rings, via restring, net classes and the Eagle clearance matrix, milling, board outlines drawn inside packages, copper layer count, and more.

Every conversion ends with a strong quality control against the original Eagle files and a strict PASS / FAIL verdict, with a Markdown report and 3D renders.

Windows: one-click import of a new design. All platforms: fix + check an already imported project (Linux/macOS: experimental).
